task_completion.description: OpenRocket application is launched and visible.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The OpenRocket window is open, showing the rocket design interface or the splash screen.

task_completion.description: The baseline rocket design 'srad_start.ork' is loaded into OpenRocket.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The window title bar or file path indicator shows 'srad_start.ork' is open.

task_completion.description: The agent opens the Motor Configuration or 'Motors and Configurations' tab to select a motor.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Motors and Configurations' tab is active, and the 'Select motor' dialog is visible.

task_completion.description: The custom motor (SRAD_Team SRAD_C40) is selected and assigned to the motor mount.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The motor selection list shows 'SRAD_C40' from manufacturer 'SRAD_Team' highlighted or assigned to the motor mount component.

task_completion.description: A flight simulation is executed within OpenRocket.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Flight Simulations' tab shows a simulation entry with a green checkmark or status 'Finished', and data for Apogee and Max Velocity are visible in the table.

task_completion.description: The modified design is saved to the specific path 'srad_simulated_rocket.ork'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Save As' dialog shows the filename 'srad_simulated_rocket.ork' or the window title updates to this name.

task_completion.description: A text report is created at the specified path with the simulation results.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal 'cat' command shows 'srad_flight_report.txt' containing numerical values for Apogee (m) and Max Velocity (m/s).

integrity.description: The agent used the OpenRocket GUI to configure the motor and run the simulation.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse cursor movement and interaction with OpenRocket menus and buttons, rather than just terminal commands.

integrity.description: The agent did not create the report before running the simulation.
integrity.visual_evidence: The timestamp of the report creation follows the visual confirmation of the simulation results in the OpenRocket GUI.

integrity.description: The agent used the provided .eng file rather than a default motor.
integrity.visual_evidence: The motor selection dialog shows the manufacturer 'SRAD_Team', which is only available if the custom .eng file was correctly loaded/referenced.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The custom motor file is located at /home/ga/Documents/motors/SRAD_C40.eng. The manufacturer name is 'SRAD_Team' and the designation is 'SRAD_C40'. The baseline file is 'srad_start.ork'. The final saved design must be 'srad_simulated_rocket.ork' and the text report must be at '/home/ga/Documents/exports/srad_flight_report.txt'. The VLM should verify that the Apogee and Max Velocity values in the text report match the values displayed in the OpenRocket 'Flight Simulations' table after the run.
